<thought>To match the observed molecular ion at m/z 194.086 (≈C₁₁H₁₄O₃) and the M+1 intensity (~13 % indicating ~11 carbons), the structure should contain 11 carbons, 14 hydrogens, and 3 oxygens. Ethyl 4‑ethoxybenzoate fits this formula (ethyl ester of p‑ethoxybenzoic acid). Its SMILES is “CCOC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1OCC”, which gives C₁₁H₁₄O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1OCC</final_answer>
